newsitem.title: USA: Cell Robotics/GEM Edwards end agreement.
newsitem.headline: Cell Robotics/GEM Edwards end agreement.

text.p: Cell Robotics International Inc said Tuesday that it and GEM Edwards Inc agreed to terminate their U.S. distribution and development arrangement.
Dissolving the agreement with GEM will allow Cell Robotics to negotiate worldwide distribution arrangements, Cell Robotics said.
Cell Robotics said it agreed to reimburse GEM for its direct expenses and will grant warrants to GEM to purchase shares of CRII stock.
Cell Robotics International Inc sells, develops and produces laser research and medical products.
